drivers.name: Holiday: Thanksgiving
drivers.evidence: Noise-adjusted x1.85 from 3 past Thanksgiving weeks; consistent uplift.

drivers.evidence: 1-day closure in 7-day week; no past closure data, so estimate 14% demand loss.

adjustment.analysis: Thanksgiving drives strong lift (x1.85 noise-adjusted). Store closure on Monday reduces demand; 1-day closure in a 7-day week implies ~14% demand loss, but no past closure data. Price unchanged. No promotion. Baseline already reflects trend and seasonality. Classical model suggests x1.85, but closure reduces it. Adjust down to x1.65. Evidence is strong for holiday, weak for closure. No need to widen spreads.
